API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIAdmin & Role ManagementAdmin Role Resource Update Role
Admin Role Resource Update Role
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/adminRoles/:roleId

Updates the admin role based on the specified ID.

Note: This endpoint is accessible via Zscaler OneAPI only.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
roleId
int32
REQUIRED

Specifies the role ID

APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

Admin role information

id
int32

Admin role ID

rank
int32

Admin rank of this admin role. This is applicable only when the admin rank is enabled in the advanced settings. Default value is 7 (the lowest rank). The assigned admin rank determines the roles or admin users this user can manage and the rule orders the admin can access.

name
string
REQUIRED

Name of the admin role

policyAccess
string

Policy access permission

Possible values: [NONE|READ_ONLY|READ_WRITE]

alertingAccess
string

Alerting access permission

Possible values: [NONE|READ_ONLY|READ_WRITE]

dashboardAccess
string

Dashboard access permission

Possible values: [NONE|READ_ONLY]

reportAccess
string

Report access permission

Possible values: [NONE|READ_ONLY|READ_WRITE]

analysisAccess
string

Insights Logs access permission

Possible values: [NONE|READ_ONLY]

usernameAccess
string

Username access permission. When set to NONE, the username is obfuscated.

Possible values: [NONE|READ_ONLY]

deviceInfoAccess
string

Device information access permission. When set to NONE, device information is obfuscated.

Possible values: [NONE|READ_ONLY]

adminAcctAccess
string

Admin and role management access permission

Possible values: [NONE|READ_WRITE]

isAuditor
boolean

Indicates whether this is an auditor role

Default value: false
permissions
string[]

List of functional areas to which this role has access. This attribute is subject to change.

Possible values: [USER_ACCESS, SECURE, MANAGE, COMPLY, SSL_POLICY, ADVANCED_SETTINGS, TRAFFIC_FORWARDING, AUTHENTICATION_CONFIGURATION, FIREWALL_DNS, NSS_CONFIGURATION, VZEN_CONFIGURATION, LOCATIONS, HOSTED_PAC_FILES, EZ_AGENT_CONFIGURATIONS, SECURE_AGENT_NOTIFICATIONS, VPN_CREDENTIALS, PROXY_GATEWAY, AUTHENTICATION_SETTINGS, IDENTITY_PROXY_SETTINGS, USER_MANAGEMENT, APIKEY_MANAGEMENT, PARTNER_INTEGRATION, POLICY_RESOURCE_MANAGEMENT, CUSTOM_URL_CAT, OVERRIDE_EXISTING_CAT, CUSTOMER_ACCT_INFO, CUSTOMER_SUBSCRIPTION, CUSTOMER_ORG_SETTINGS, REMOTE_ASSISTANCE_MANAGEMENT]

featurePermissions
object
extFeaturePermissions
object
isNonEditable
boolean

Indicates whether or not this admin user is editable

Default value: false
logsLimit
string

Enter the number of days an admin with this role can view logs. Admins can view real-time logs of every transaction performed by your users regardless of where they are in the world.

Possible values: [UNRESTRICTED, MONTH_1, MONTH_2, MONTH_3, MONTH_4, MONTH_5, MONTH_6]

roleType
string

The admin role type. This attribute is subject to change.

Possible values: [ORG_ADMIN|EXEC_INSIGHT|EXEC_INSIGHT_AND_ORG_ADMIN|SDWAN]

reportTimeDuration
int32

Time duration allocated to the report dashboard. The default value of -1 indicates that no time restriction is applied to the report dashboard. Time Unit is in hours.

Responses
​
200
401
403
404
500

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
